office: the Ministry of Internal Affairs' migration service, through the Government for Citizens centres (ЦОН)
note: The state duty is the Tax Code's (art. 667 para. 3): 4 monthly calculation indices (MRP) for 24 pages (for children under 16), 8 for 36, 12 for 48; the MRP is 4,325 tenge in 2026 (the republican budget law for 2026–2028). Exemptions from the duty aren't modelled. Validity by age and the processing time are leads: egov.kz's passport FAQ no longer renders and gov.kz's guide didn't load its steps. Consular fees abroad (art. 675) are leads.
